{{Quote|I am an exhaust ventilation technician for the mines. It is my job to make sure that the mine's exhaust system is working correctly. Of course, that is when the Mandalorians let me do my job.|Labsol Renuffi|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Labsol Renuffi''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who operated out of the [[Death Watch bunker|Death Watch Bunker]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Labsol Renuffi was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
